\noindent{\small ATT\&CK Enterprise 20.0 (2026-10-13, SHA-256 81113BA98AFA2928…): 479 Windows techniques and sub-techniques; 475 with at least one trace WAC collects, 4 whose sources are all off the disk; 6 (marked *) have no Windows analytic in ATT\&CK and are decided from the technique itself. \emph{Logs}: a log WAC takes holds a trace of the technique; \emph{Disk}: an artefact on the disk does, beyond the logs. A Windows event log is only there if the machine kept it: WAC records the channels' configuration and the audit policy, which say so.}

\noindent{\small Sources not taken, and why: ETW, live telemetry (ETW, API calls, performance counters): never written to the disk; NSM, network capture: on the wire, not on the machine; cloud, cloud service: in the tenant's logs, not on the machine; EDR, an EDR product's own telemetry: in its console; firmware, firmware: not read, WAC reads the disk; 4.0, server role (IIS, AD FS, domain controller): version 4.0; AI, an AI model's behaviour: ATT\&CK names no trace of it on Windows}
